meta.title: Recent sessions
meta.description: A Recent sessions row sits above Settings in the sidebar. Opening it floats a sheet over the workspace list with the latest sessions by last activity. A search field at the top takes focus when the sheet opens and filters by session title, workspace name or path, session ID and state; Escape clears it and drops focus. Clicking a row opens that session, collapses the sheet, and scrolls the sidebar to its workspace, expanding the group first when it is collapsed. Two switches sit at the top: Subagents decides how subagent sessions are handled—folded into their main session (the main row ranks by the newest activity in its subtree and expands in place), hidden entirely, or one row each; Range limits the list to the last 1, 7 or 30 days, or no limit. Both save to the profile's plugin config. The sheet spans the sidebar width and paints an opaque surface; archived sessions stay in the sidebar's archive. The entry row also carries the list's status dots: yellow when a listed session is waiting on you, green when a finished session has not been opened yet, both at once and without counts.
